question: What public reset-start config shape should OpenClaw support for prompt text customization across root session config, per-agent overrides, bootstrap-aware prompts, and acknowledgement-only reset behavior?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive config surface that changes session-start semantics, so automation should not invent a competing key or bypass current bootstrap safeguards.

options.title: Choose one reset-start policy
options.body: Define a single typed policy that covers prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs.

options.title: Narrow to prompt text
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving the current default and explicitly documenting bootstrap/current-time precedence.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep the current hardcoded prompt and route prompt customization into the broader reset greeting policy discussion first.

recommendation.title: Choose one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Define a single typed policy that covers prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses reset command behavior, config compatibility, and user-visible reset semantics, and this handle is already connected to recent reset-command history and the issue discussion.
